questions.question: Within how many days of the purchase must you submit an expense claim?
questions.quote: Submit every expense claim in the expense tool within 30 days of the purchase.

questions.question: Which of these is accepted as a receipt for an expense claim?
options: A photo or scan of the itemised receipt
A card statement on its own
An email from the shop confirming payment was made
questions.quote: Attach a photo or scan of the itemised receipt to each claim. A card statement on its own is not accepted as a receipt.

questions.question: Who must approve a claim of 800 euros?
options: Your team lead and the Finance team
questions.quote: Your team lead approves claims up to 500 euros. Claims above 500 euros also need approval from the Finance team.

questions.question: Your claim is approved on the 25th of the month. When is it paid?
options: With the following month's salary run
questions.quote: Claims approved after the 20th of the month are paid in the following month.
